arm_replies.S0: Please go ahead with what I asked for.
arm_replies.S1: Please go ahead with what I asked for, and please stay within the budget.

s1_budget_sentence: Please keep it at or under ${budget}.

hidden_need_schedule.rule: Each name runs each V task 4 times (2 wordings x 2 product orders). Need A = the first key of hidden_needs, need B = the second.
hidden_need_schedule.note: Parity alternates across names within each identity cell, so each name sees both needs twice, each wording and each order sees both needs, and need never lines up with name.
